subject: Reschedule request — demo falls during stakeholder travel
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@roswellhealth.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request to move next week’s demo (stakeholder travel)

Hi Sean,

Hope you’re well. Quick note — a number of our decision-makers are on a destination wedding trip the week we had scheduled (Oct 2). That includes our VP of Engineering and two clinical leads, so we won’t have the full set of stakeholders available for a live walk-through.

Would you be able to either:
- Move the demo to the following week (Oct 9–13), or
- Send a short recorded demo we can watch asynchronously and then do a 30‑minute live Q&A / office hours session with the core team on Oct 4 or Oct 5?

If you have SOC2 summary docs and a short architecture slide for the deployment model, please include those — our procurement/security team will want them.

Thanks,
Emily Park
Senior PM, Roswell Health
emily.park@roswellhealth.com
+1 415-555-0192
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Emily Park <emily.park@roswellhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-20T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to move next week’s demo (stakeholder travel)

Hi Emily — thanks for the heads-up and congrats to the wedding party (hope it’s a lovely trip).

We can do either approach. Quick options:
1) Move the full live demo to the week of Oct 9 — I can send 3× 60‑minute slots and we’ll make sure Laura (SE) covers architecture and Tessa (CS) covers onboarding/cost ops.
2) We can record a 12–15 minute demo highlighting the deployment options and KV/cache behavior, attach the short deck, and schedule a 30‑minute office hours session on Oct 4 (we have availability at 10:00am PT and 3:00pm PT).

I’ve attached a short one‑pager and a trimmed demo deck (redwood-demo-short.pdf) for your procurement folks. For SOC2 docs, I’ll share the summary link to our compliance portal — happy to jump on a call with your security lead if they want details.

Which option do you prefer? If you want the recording + office hours, which time on Oct 4 works better for your team?

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 206-555-0147

Attachment: redwood-demo-short.pdf (12 slides)
From: Emily Park <emily.park@roswellhealth.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@roswellhealth.com
Date: 2026-09-20T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to move next week’s demo (stakeholder travel)

Thanks Sean — recording + office hours sounds best for this week. 3 reasons: smaller group can review asynchronously, procurement can triage SOC2 items, and then the core stakeholders (who are traveling) can join the live Q&A when they’re back.

Can you record the short demo and put it on a share link? For office hours, let’s do Oct 4 at 3:00pm PT. I’ll put a tentative hold on that time for Laura (VP Eng) but she may not be able to join live — the clinical lead team (Dr. Milton and Samir) will try to attend.

Procurement asked to see the SOC2 summary link (noted in your email). Please send that and any short deployment diagram you have.

Appreciate the flexibility,
Emily
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Emily Park <emily.park@roswellhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-21T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to move next week’s demo (stakeholder travel)

Perfect — I’ll record the demo and upload the link by EOD tomorrow. Oct 4, 3:00pm PT is confirmed for 30 minutes (calendar invite sent).

SOC2 summary: https://drive.redwood.ai/link/soc2-redwood-summary
Demo recording link (when ready): https://cal.redwood.ai/evt/abcd1234

Laura — can you attach a 1‑page infra diagram for Roswell’s security team? Tessa — I’ll include you on the office hours invite to cover onboarding and support SLAs.

Thanks everyone — we’ll aim for a tight 12–15 minute walkthrough and save the rest for Q&A.

Best,
Sean
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Emily Park <emily.park@roswellhealth.com>, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-23T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to move next week’s demo (stakeholder travel)

Hi Emily — attached is a lightweight infra diagram showing the Private (VPC) and Dedicated flow we discussed. I also included a short note on data retention and key management options.

Attachment: sample-infra-diagram.png (800×600 PNG)

If procurement has any questions after reviewing the SOC2 summary and this diagram, I can join the office hours or take a separate 20‑minute sync with your security lead.

See you all on Oct 4, 3:00pm PT.

— Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
